description: Distinguishes repairing a cloned C++ dependency checkout from creating an app or installing machine-wide tools.
prompt: Just cloned Cairnwatch and the winrt includes are missing. MSVC and the Windows SDK are installed. How do I restore the versions in packages.config and rerun cppwinrt?

paraphrases.novice: I downloaded Cairnwatch, but the editor can't find the Windows-related includes. The computer has the required software. How do I get the libraries and generated files our team uses, at the versions listed here?
paraphrases.terse: Cairnwatch clone missing winrt includes. Restore recorded dependencies and regenerate headers.
